verdict.rationale: The docs say n8n can be self-hosted on your own infrastructure, on-premises, or in a private cloud via Docker Compose or a one-line installer. Without a license key it runs as the free Community edition, and the standard version is on GitHub. Multiple community users independently confirm years of easy self-hosting in production, some at high volume on small servers. Missing for 10: the license is fair-code (Sustainable Use License) rather than OSS, and some capabilities need a license key or a separate commercial agreement (e.g. OEM embedding), so 'self-host' does not mean unrestricted open-source use.
